notes.title: Play Beneath Her Gaze Early Access
notes.notes:
[p]You can play it now! Download for free!

One route/linear/Kinect [b][i]Ecchi[/i][/b] [b][i]Visual Novel[/i][/b] about a woman who is...kinda tall. 

Discover all the mysteries about her. Dive into madness. Control your urges.[/p][h2]Features[/h2][list][*][p]Unique and original [b]Art Style[/b] drawn by hand. Many illustrations and animations[/p][/*][*][p]Original Sound Track with 8 songs made by professional musician.[/p][/*][*][p]40 Minutes worth of Content. (35 to 40% of the total of the story).[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]It's linear, but you do have some choices. Continue the main story or discover many lose scenarios and unlock extra content along the way.[/p][/*][*][p]Unlock a extra Pet Mini-Game. (Play with her, keep her alive and click to talk).[/p][/*][*][p]A minimalist UI coupled with an aesthetically-pleasing 4:3 resolution.[/p][/*][*][p]Free.[/p][/*][/list]
